Model scope and limits

UMa mean path loss with BS 25 m, UE 1.5 m and 10 m-5 km horizontal distance. Scenario mode applies qualified carrier templates, azimuth, downtilt and the TR 38.901 reference element, isotropic pattern or explicit uniform-panel array. Array EIRP is an upper bound before element scan loss; total beam power is shared across elements. Source-cell mode uses explicit imported paths and uncorrelated mean-power sums with shared radio budgets; other equipment remains source evidence. Terrain/clutter, MIMO, reference-signal allocation, interference, handover and service performance are outside these models. Predictions are uncalibrated planning received power.
